description: This file defines the ConfigDao class, a data access object responsible for managing configuration key-value pairs in the OrangeHRM system. It provides methods to set, get, and retrieve all configuration values from the database.

classes.name: ConfigDao
classes.description: A data access object class for managing configuration entities in the database, providing methods to set, get, and list configuration values.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets a configuration key to a specified value, creating a new config if it does not exist.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value associated with a configuration key.

methods.name: getAllValues
methods.description: Returns an associative array of all configuration key-value pairs.
